$comment: Agent 365 deployment plan — SECRET-FREE. Generated/edited by the Lab Builder wizard. Schema: .github/skills/agent365-wizard/references/deployment-plan-schema.md

solution.$comment_foundry: OPTIONAL — only if the lab has FH/FD agents. All FH+FD agents share this ONE Foundry footprint. mode 'create-shared' = the wizard provisions one account+project '<SOLUTION_PREFIX>'+model in <SOLUTION_PREFIX>-foundry-rg; mode 'reuse-existing' = deploy into an existing project (set endpoint/account/existingResourceGroup, no provision — the resilient path if new-account hosted-agent provisioning is degraded). Remove this block for the legacy per-agent-account behaviour. FH-DW always keeps its own account.
solution.$comment_azureOpenAI: OPTIONAL — only if the lab has ACA agents. All ACA agents share this ONE Azure OpenAI footprint. mode 'create-shared' (DEFAULT) = the wizard creates a lab-owned account '<SOLUTION_PREFIX>aoai' + deployment in <SOLUTION_PREFIX>-aoai-rg (deleted by the Lab Cleaner via the prefix); mode 'reuse-existing' = deploy against an existing account (set account/existingResourceGroup, no creation). Remove this block for the legacy per-agent 'ai' behaviour.
